'''Diplomatic Spaceport 27-B''' was a spaceport located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[3640 BBY]], and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Teff'ith]] landed the [[Prosperity (shuttle)|''Prosperity'']] there when she attempted to find [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]].
